title: Excelytra
description: Mod that adds an elytra crafting recipe and some other things
body:
this is a mod that doesnt remove elytras from the end ships, but adds a structure similar to an amythest geode in the end where you can get a new template to upgrade normal phantom membrane to an upgraded version.

these upgraded membranes can be combined with netherite scraps to make one of the two wings neccesary to craft a full elytra.

Once you have two wings and two reionforced membranes, you can finally craft an elytra with some endstone and fireworks to make the elytra and it works as normal.
